title: no-comments scope configuration
description: Declares which files the comment-policy predicate governs at this repository root. Membership is derived from units[].roots crossed with the extensions of each unit's family, plus any explicit units[].files; it is never restated as a list of globs.

version.description: The schema major this file is written against. A predicate that does not recognise the major refuses to load rather than reading a shape it cannot represent; unknown additive keys under a recognised major load and are reported.

families.description: Grammar families, keyed by id. A family names the extensions it owns and the extractor that reads its comment grammar.

units.description: Named scope units. Each crosses one family with a list of roots.

exclude.description: Globs removed from membership, evaluated before include. A `**/<name>/**` entry additionally prunes any directory called <name> during discovery.

literalPath.description: A repository-relative path naming exactly one file. Unlike a glob it is never expanded and never matched: discovery stats it, so a wildcard or a brace could not add a member while the matcher would still route whatever it matched into this unit. The same canonicalization as `glob` applies, and an absolute path or a `..` segment is refused by name at load.

glob.description: A repository-relative glob over `*`, `**`, brace alternations and literal segments. Braces expand at load, and the loader canonicalizes each expansion before anything reads it: a leading `./` is stripped, repeated slashes collapse, and a trailing `/` is dropped, so `./packages/` and `packages` are the same declaration and `.` is the only spelling of the repository root. The matcher sees no braces and no `./`. An absolute path or a `..` segment is refused by name at load rather than normalized, because either one names a tree the root does not own.

extractor.description: Id of the comment extractor that reads this grammar family.

roots.description: Directory prefixes, optionally carrying `*` or `**`. `.` means the repository root itself and is the one non-recursive root.

files.description: Paths that are members without matching a root, for scripts an extension-keyed rule can never discover. Each names one file: wildcards and braces are refused at load. A path carrying an extension must carry one whose extractor matches its own family, since the unit reads it under that extractor regardless. An extensionless path is the intended case under a hash family whose extensions resolve to a single dialect, and is refused under c-family, which takes its file class from the extension.

allowEmpty.description: Set when a unit is expected to discover nothing. Without it, a unit that matches no file is a loud failure rather than a silent zero.
